name: AI Maturity & Learning
notes: **Added 29 September (AI functions review, the product owner's "build it right, it gets more accurate with time").** No customer is told an AI feature "comes later": every answer starts from a baseline and learns. This is where the venue sees how far each answer has come, gives the figures the baseline stands on, and imports its own history from the systems it used before TICVAI. Importing 12 months or more moves the answers it covers straight to Established.
patternReason: `listAiCapabilityMaturity` reads a population (one row per question the AI answers) and the detail is the row
purpose: See where each AI answer stands, what it is based on and what it needs next; set the venue AI profile; import the venue's own history.

components.label: Every AI answer, by stage
components.notes: Stage badge, the "Based on" line, the share of own data and what the next stage needs.

components.label: Venue AI profile
components.notes: **The venue can correct its profile at any time** — the honest answer to a baseline that is wrong for an unusual venue in the first weeks.

components.label: Import findings
components.notes: Each rejected row and why, so the venue can fix the export and import again.

components.label: Import history
components.notes: **Loaded into the AI data only, never the ledger**: an imported sale teaches the forecast and is never counted as revenue. The form says so.

states.loading: The stage of each answer; the venue profile resolves separately.
states.error: Could not load. **Every AI answer still works** — this page reports on them and changes none.
states.emptyFirstRun: **Nothing answered yet.** Every question starts at Starting from the venue AI profile and the starting pattern for the venue type. The action fills in the profile, or imports history.
states.emptyNoResults: No answer is at this stage. Names the filter and offers to clear it.
states.emptyNoAccess: You do not have AI permission at this venue. Names `AI_USE`, and `AI_CONFIGURE` for the profile and imports.

entryState.coldEntry: A link from an import-finished notification opens the import named by `importId`; without it the page opens on the maturity list.

overlays.body: **Collects what `setAiVenueSettings` sends before it is called.** Required: `venueId`, `venueType`. Any figure left empty takes the starting pattern's default for the venue type.

**Collects what `importVenueHistory` sends before it is called.** Required: `dataKind`, `assetId` (the uploaded export), `columnMapping`. Optional: `sourceSystem`, `dryRun` (check without loading). A second import of the same kind and period replaces the first.

targetApp.name: TICVAI Venue Management
targetApp.note: **Already one app in all but name** — P08, P13 and P16 declared the same `app` before this decision. One tenant-level surface that filters across venues, with analytics, CMS and the support desk as sections of it.
